⚙️ Google Sheets Integration

Connect your website with your Google Sheet using our free Google Apps Script Web App. This allows live 2-way syncing for listings and authorized admin user logins!
📋 Quick Setup:
  1. Open your Google Sheet and click Extensions > Apps Script.
  2. Paste the provided script from admin-guide/GoogleAppsScript.js.
  3. Click Deploy > New deployment > Web app.
  4. Set access to "Anyone" and copy your Web App URL here!
